summary: Correctly resolves the transition issue by emitting legacy-format session data when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM=='sha1', matching the existing _legacy_decode path so other instances during the 3.0→3.1 transition can decode it. Mergeable; only minor structural/comment nits.

issues.description: Legacy encoding is inlined in encode() rather than extracted to a _legacy_encode() helper symmetric with the existing _legacy_decode(); a small helper would read cleaner and mirror the decode side.

Missing a marker comment (e.g. RemovedInDjango40Warning) noting that the sha1 branch is temporary transition code tied to the deprecated DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM setting; the generic 'Use legacy encoding format' comment doesn't convey removal intent.
